poly_lut_invert — DRIVE tacscalib op

• Data kinds: rgb × table × image2d → normalmap

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.poly_lut_invert(rgb, poly: 'dict', mask=None, method: 'str' = 'coarse') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import tacscalib; tacscalib.poly_lut_invert(rgb, poly: 'dict', mask=None, method: 'str' = 'coarse') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("poly_lut_invert"))

Usage

Adapter: passes an external position-dependent polynomial LUT (bins and grad_r / grad_g / grad_b = (bins, bins, 6); a format in which 6 coefficients per bin [x², y², xy, x, y, 1], with x = column and y = row in raw pixels, express each background-subtracted channel) through the same inverse lookup as gradient_lut_invert (same binning, same coarse → fine). rgb is the difference after the same background processing as in the external pipeline. Since every bin of the external table is filled, all bins are used. Raises ValueError: missing key / coefficients not of shape (bins, bins, 6) / non-finite.
